name: success-skill
description: Keep customers after they buy — support, health, renewals

interface.shortDescription: Keep customers after they buy — support, health, renewals
interface.longDescription: Post-purchase work with the epistemics attached: whether a distinct success function is warranted yet, the onboarding program (not the in-product flow), help content and knowledge base, support process and SLAs as promises, AI-support policy, health and churn-risk signals, voice-of-customer interpretation, retention execution, renewals and expansion, and customer-facing incident comms. The flagship answers what a health score can actually predict, why a correct prediction may not help, and whether the churn event is observable at all.
defaultPrompt: Use $success to audit our customer health score and tell me what it can honestly predict.
